title: VPC optimization: config sandbox, staged-apply simulator, and policy enforcement
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Deliver a safe, policy-aware 'config sandbox' and 'staged-apply simulator' for automated batching/caching recommendations targeted at Private/VPC/on-prem tenants. The feature will let operators preview optimization changes (batch sizes, KV cache policies, quantization suggestions) against historical traffic in an offline/simulated environment, enforce org-level policy constraints, and provide a staged commit path with automated rollback and manual approval hooks for environments that disallow live automatic changes.

Why: Customers running in Private or on-prem environments require strict change controls, auditability, and predictable risk profiles. Current autotuner suggestions are useful but cannot be safely applied in many VPC/on-prem contexts without an offline verification and policy check step. This ticket implements the middle-layer (sandbox + policy gate + staged apply) that bridges recommendations to production apply.

Non-goals: This ticket does NOT add new kernel-level optimizations or change serving runtime — it focuses on the configuration lifecycle, simulation, and policy enforcement. It also does not replace enterprise change management workflows (it integrates with them).

Constraints:
- No external traffic leaves customer VPC during simulation. Simulation runs on an isolated replica of metrics and request traces.
- On-prem air-gapped installs may run the sandbox in an operator-controlled namespace; the default must be conservative (no enabled KV cache/large batch by default).
- Policy engine must support declarative constraints (deny/require/threshold) and be evaluated prior to staged apply.

Success metrics (post-release):
- Percent of recommendations accepted by customers with staged apply improved by 35% vs current manual process.
- Rollback rate < 2% in first 90 days for VPC customers using staged apply.
- No customer-reported incidents caused by automated applies in private deployments.

Stakeholders: Platform reliability, Serving runtime, Security & Compliance, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success.
acceptance_criteria: Sandbox runs reproductions of recent traffic (1k-100k requests) without egress from customer VPC and produces cost/latency delta estimates.
Policy engine evaluates recommendations and returns allow/deny with rationale; policies are editable by tenant admins.
Staged-apply flow: (1) simulation -> (2) operator review -> (3) scheduled canary -> (4) automatic monitored commit/rollback based on SLOs.
On-prem installer has a toggle to require manual approval for all applies; default for VPC is conservative safe-default config.
Audit log entries are emitted for every simulation, policy decision, staged apply, and rollback with links to artifacts.
E2E tests validate that simulated metrics approximate live behavior within an acceptable delta (latency +/-10%, cost variance <20%).
rollout_plan: MVP gated feature: sandbox + policy evaluation + manual staged apply for 5 pilot tenants (mix of VPC and on-prem).
Collect metrics and adjust conservative defaults after pilot (2-week observation window).
Enable automated canary commit for tenants that opt-in and pass policy rules and monitored thresholds.
Document flow and admin controls in Console (toggle, history, revert button) and ship with release notes and runbook.
monitoring_signals: pre/post-simulation cost estimate and actual cost delta (tokens/sec, GPU-hours)
latency P50/P95/P99 before and after staged apply on canary traffic
rollback triggers fired (errors, SLO violations), rollback rate per tenant
simulation vs live accuracy drift metric
decisions: Use an isolated read-only replay of anonymized request traces for offline simulation to avoid PII leakage.
Sandbox will run as a namespaced job inside the customer's VPC or on-prem cluster; no managed egress required.
Policy language: start with JSON/YAML declarative policies (denylist/allowlist, numeric thresholds), iterate to Rego if needed.
Default conservative profile: max batch size 8, KV cache disabled for session-scoped models, quantization suggestions set to 'suggest' not 'apply'.
open_risks: Simulation fidelity: some workloads (heavy long-context chat) may not be captured accurately by short trace replays.
Operators may over-trust simulation output; need clear confidence intervals and human-in-the-loop approvals.
On-prem installs with limited telemetry may reduce simulation accuracy; require guidance and documented limitations.
Policy conflicts with existing tenant change-control processes (need integration adapters or manual override path).
